Our modern and elegant Guest House is situated in one of the most beautiful areas of Cape Town: Hout Bay.
With a unique and quiet hillside location in an upmarket and sought-after neighbourhood, with stunning views of the mountains and ocean, you can take comfort in knowing you will have a beautiful and safe experience during your stay in our villa. And at our large pool you will find the serenity and relaxation you are longing for. Let us spoil you!
Each of our our five rooms is individual. They not only differ in size and shape, but they are also furnished to match their particular charm. Most of them provide beautiful views and an own terrace.
However, the room amenities are the same in all rooms, while Corner Suite, Cosmopolitan Suite and Comb View also provide air conditioning.
From honeymoon to road trip – we offer rooms for every occasion and for every budget. We will gladly assist you in choosing the perfect accommodation for your stay.
The room rate includes our breakfast, which we serve on our large terrace directly by the pool.
Look forward to crispy rolls, homemade jam, various egg dishes, fruit, fresh juices, as well as coffee and tea specialities!
Of course, we also fulfil your vegan dietary requirements.
## Guest Reviews from TripAdvisor
> My girlfriend and I stayed at the Cube for a week and absolutely loved it. The Comb View room has a great view and everything is taken care of in the room (including Apple TV and a well-stocked mini-bar).“
> The view of Hout Bay from the Corner Suite is fantastic and I have rarely slept in such comfortable bed.
> Great view from the balcony / terrace of the Cosmopolitan Suite of mountains and sea. Nice room with good facilities. Open bathroom, which means the whole suite is one room.
> We had the Courtyard room, which was very tastefully decorated. All rooms were equipped with a well-stocked minibar and espresso machine.
> We got the wonderful Corner Suite with sea view for the first few days, it is bright with a super comfortable bed, plenty of pillows and from the floor to ceiling windows you look out over the green, manicured property full of palm trees to the sea.
> We booked the Concord room (as only this and the cottage were available). It is nicely furnished and has everything you need.
> The Comb View Room keeps what the pictures on the homepage promise. We felt very comfortable with the modern architecture and the stylish interior. The room in fact is like an own small house next to the main building and has its own private separate sun deck with a wonderful view.
> We stayed at the Cube for the second time and were totally thrilled again! This time we booked the Cosmopolitan Suite, which is modernly furnished, offers a lot of space and also has a great view.
> We stayed for 5 days in the Concord Suite where all the details were just right, a comfortable bed, perfect pillows, a timer for the fridge so that nothing disturbs our sleep and for all techies and Apple fans, Apple TV and also a South African mobile phone are available for the guests.
> Unfortunately we could only stay 3 days at the CUBE (next time it will be longer). We really enjoyed the terrific breakfast, the wonderful hospitality of Dirk and his team and our room Concord, which had just been refurbished. We will be back!
